response.justification: Bogdan demonstrates deep systems expertise across distributed, high-throughput environments and strong ownership through operational roles, with direct exposure to AI-agent tooling at re:cinq — aligning well with the agentic engineering mindset. His cross-stack fluency, open-source leadership, and operational experience (CI/CD, on-call readiness) meet core requirements, though limited explicit Python depth and minimal evidence of agile scrum champion rotation are minor gaps.
strengths: Proven experience in distributed, high-throughput systems (e.g., millions of requests/sec at Dunnhumby)
Direct exposure to AI-agent infrastructure and code generation tools at re:cinq
Strong operational ownership with CI/CD, dev-ops setup, and incident-ready tooling experience
concerns: Python expertise not explicitly highlighted despite being a must-have
No clear evidence of rotating scrum champion or formal agile ceremony leadership
German language proficiency is basic, potentially limiting stakeholder alignment in Berlin-based team
